method: authenticated read-only Devpost Hackathons connector calls

registration.reason: User is already registered for this hackathon

accountRelationship.resolution: The account-level submitted relationship is not treated as proof of submission because the exact project is submission_pre_draft with submittedAt null.

latestAnnouncement.summary: The announcement reiterates the deadline, named WebMCP judging environments, public YouTube video under three minutes with audio, public source repository and post-start evidence requirements.

limitations: This is a time-bounded read-only observation of editable Devpost state, not a frozen submission receipt.
Only an authorised final submission and its returned receipt can establish that the project was submitted.
Entrant eligibility, residence, rights, publicity, prize and tax attestations remain human decisions at submission time.
